Total revenues for fiscal year 2014 were $3,651,181, an increase of $1,131,438, or 44.9%, from revenues for fiscal year 2013 of $2,519,743. The increase in revenues for fiscal year 2014 as compared to the prior year was due to higher unit volume sales of endocouplers, endoscopes, micro optics and initial sales of scanning otoscopes and 120 degree fiber scopes, which was partially offset by lower unit volume sales of the advanced surgical visualization system used in spinal surgery.
